title: SafeStep Roster Limits, Activation Lead Times and Removal Forfeiture
content:
# Roster Limits and Activation — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

Each SafeStep tier sets the largest roster the program may hold, the business days needed to activate a participant added to the roster, and whether a removed participant's unused allowance is forfeited on removal.

| Tier | Largest roster size (participants) | Business days to activate a participant added to the roster | Removed participant's unused allowance forfeited on removal |
|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 50 | 2 | Yes |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 150 | 2 | Yes |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 400 | 1 | Yes |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 1000 | 1 | Yes |
| SafeStep Premier | 3000 | 1 | Yes |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 10000 | 0 | Yes |

## Notes

- **Largest roster size** is the most participants the program's roster may hold at any time on that tier.
- **Activation lead time** is counted in business days. A figure of 0, on SafeStep Enterprise, means no activation lead time.
- **Forfeiture on removal** applies on every tier: when a participant is removed, that participant's unused allowance is forfeited on removal.

## Comparison points

- A roster of 120 participants (hypothetical) is within the largest roster size of SafeStep Voucher Plus (150) but above that of SafeStep Voucher Basic (50).
- SafeStep Voucher Basic and SafeStep Voucher Plus activate an added participant within 2 business days; the next three tiers within 1 business day.
